interactions.note: The crystal structure of the insulin receptor (IR-A) ectodomain dimer complexed with four Fabs from mAbs 83-7 and 83-14 was determined. Fab 83-7 binds one monomer of the antigen homodimer at the CR (cysteine-rich) domain.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 3.8 angstroms

The epitope of Fab 83-7 on the insulin receptor ectodomain was determined from the crystal structure of complex A of Fab 83-7 in complex with the insulin receptor L1-CR construct IR310.T + αCT(704-719) bound to human insulin A/B chains. Fab 83-7 binds to insulin receptor at the CR (cysteine-rich) domain.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 3.9 angstroms

The epitope of Fab 83-7 on the insulin receptor ectodomain was determined from the crystal structure of complex B of Fab 83-7 in complex with the insulin receptor L1-CR construct IR310.T + αCT(704-719) bound to high-affinity insulin analogue [D-Pro-B26]-DTI-NH2. Fab 83-7 binds to insulin receptor at the CR (cysteine-rich) domain.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 4.3 angstroms

The epitope of Fab 83-7 on the insulin receptor ectodomain was determined from the crystal structure of complex C of Fab 83-7 in complex with the insulin receptor L1-CR construct IR310.T + αCT(697-719) bound to high-affinity insulin analogue [D-Pro-B26]-DTI-NH2. Fab 83-7 binds to insulin receptor at the CR (cysteine-rich) domain.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 4.3 angstroms
The epitope-specific Fab 83-7 in complex with the insulin receptor L1-CR construct IR310.T + αCT(704-719) bound to porcine insulin was demonstrated by isothermal calorimetry.

The epitope of Fab 83-7 on the insulin receptor ectodomain was determined from the crystal structure of the quaternary complex of the insulin receptor L1-CR construct IR310.T, human insulin AB chains, the insulin receptor αCT(704-719) peptide and Fab 83-7 ("Complex A"). Fab 83-7 binds to insulin receptor at the CR (cysteine-rich) domain.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 3.5 angstroms

The epitope of Fab 83-7 on the insulin receptor was determined from the crystal structure of a complex of Fabs 83-7 and 83-14 bound to the insulin receptor ectodomain (IRΔβ construct). This structure is a revision of structures PDB: 2DTG and 3LOH, refined against refraction data extending to 3.3 Å derived from an alternative crystal. This structure corrects errors in the original modeling of fibronectin type III domains (FnIII-1 and -3) and the insert domain (ID) as well as in the underlying sequences. PDB: 4ZXB obsoletes PDB 2DTG and 3LOH.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 3.3 angstroms

The epitope of Fv 83-7 on the insulin receptor was determined from the crystal structure of a complex of Fv 83-7 bound to the insulin receptor ectodomain (IR310.T) bound to the C-terminal Site 1 compoment SC519C16 (SLDESFYDWFERQLG) of the synthetic peptide S519.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 3.27 angstroms
